items.comments: I loved this place! Can't wait to go back.

Loved my stay at the hostel.  The bed was pretty comfortable, bathrooms were clean and the free breakfast in the morning was a definite plus.  It was so nice to be right across the street from Pike Place market.  I could walk to all the main attractions.

I was quite hurried the day that I booked this reservation and I did not take the time to research all the specifics. However, it was a rather interesting place. The best things about it were: Location, Security, & the Free Breakfast. Overall, my stay was too short for me to form any substantial opinions, but compared to the cost of other lodging options in Downtown Seattle (Pikes Market), this was a value.
